evidence: Touches the script interpreter (`src/script/interpreter.cpp`) with the Consensus label, altering execution data structures and performance characteristics during transaction verification.
rationale: Addresses speculative interpreter DoS and memory overhead from potential future soft forks that may raise stack element limits to 10 kB. The author notes that "duplicating and hashing cost only a single weight unit in tapscript... forces all validators to evaluate OP_RIPEMD160 about 4284 times, each on the same 10kb input," but under current consensus limits of 520 bytes the underlying problem is not active and the mitigation remains speculative.
